subject: Data storage (possible representations when implementation provides multiple ways of storing data)
notes: kb/Work PB547 LANDED. A.1 item 46 (8.5.1.1): the complete specification of the possible representations is the USAGE clause row of each usage (205-211, 213-216, 48, 74, 217), indexed by docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-46 with one fixed representation per usage and no per-compilation-unit option. The DISPLAY arm is single-valued: one byte per character position (item 209); a position holds a UTF-16 code unit (items 33, 188); a code unit above U+00FF other than HIGH-VALUE reads at every in-memory byte channel as ? with EC-DATA-CONVERSION (StorageByte.ImageByte; CobolBits and CobolNum.Image views; CONVERT BYTE/HEX/ANY) and is refused at the file channel with I-O status 91 (item 31, owner decision R47). Witnesses: the two pb547 conformance cases. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/Intrinsics/CobolIntrinsics.Text.cs#ByteSub (the symbol is deleted: CONVERT RawBytes and every REDEFINES view now share StorageByte.ImageByte (kb/Work PB547))
